decisions.choice: Proposed: (1) www redirect in the Worker: a new outer middleware entrypoint src/outer-middleware.ts composes sequence(wwwRedirect, namespaceGuard); every request whose Host is www.repoglance.com (any case, with or without port) answers 301 to https://repoglance.com plus the same path and query, including /_emdash (Access protects both hosts; the apex login continues), with no body; the adapter marks the 301 no-store at the edge. (2) Edge cache through Astro 7's route cache with the Cloudflare adapter's provider (cacheCloudflare()), which turns on Cloudflare's Workers Cache (cache.enabled in the generated deploy config; no new resource, no KV, no Cache API code); the page frontmatter calls Astro.cache.set with EmDash's cacheHint plus the collection tag pages, maxAge 300 and swr 60 for rendered 200 pages (CMS or seed) and sets Vary: Host, Cookie; everything else, including /_emdash (EmDash opts out), the 404 page and the 301, carries Cloudflare-CDN-Cache-Control: no-store by the adapter's default, so the fail-closed guard runs for every namespace request. Invalidation: EmDash purges the entry and collection tags through the Workers cache.purge binding on every write that changes live content; the cache is keyed by Worker version so a deploy starts cold; the 5-minute TTL is the backstop if a purge fails. (3) Proof: unit tests for the host logic and the cache policy; smoke checks for the www 301s, the apex and default host unaffected, the cache headers on / and /testers, no-store on the namespace, the 404 and the redirect; live after deploy: cf-cache-status MISS then HIT with TTFB before and after, www 301 after warming the apex (proves the Host variant), /_emdash still Access-gated.
decisions.domain: www-redirect-and-cache-009: a permanent redirect from www.repoglance.com to the apex and edge caching for the anonymous public pages, both in the Worker, with the fail-closed /_emdash guard kept ahead of the cache
